title: Wheelchair Back Carry
text: Wheelchair Back Carry. I ordered this wonderful product, because we live in Florida and take the wheel chair for long distances, this holds jackets, food, and even my large purse when I push the wheel chair.  Wonderful product und excellent quality, will last a long time. Also inexpensive. Fast delivery, hassle free.  Inge Coffman[[ASIN:B000BO8GYC Duro-Med Wheel Chair Back Pack, Black]]

product_metadata.title: Nylon Wheelchair Backpack Bag Carry Pouch Accessory 17½” x 16½” x 4½”
description: Wheelchair Back Carry Ons . Adjustable straps easily slip over push handles of wheelchairs. . Large deep pockets for many personal items and extra storage. . High quality, water resistant nylon. . Available in black, 17½” x 16½” x 4½”.
